CustomField.inlineHelpText:
If a delay exception was approved, was there no reasonable opportunity for ANZ to provide the IDR letter within the IDR timeframe because:
resolution of the individual complaint is particularly complex (see RG 271.67 for examples of ‘complexity’); and/or
circumstances beyond ANZ's control are causing complaint management delays; and
did the delay notification provided to the complainant contain reasons for the delay and AFCA contact details?
CustomField.label: IDR delay notice & decision appropriate?
